title: What's new in 1.0.10
description:
• Language preference — local TTS now follows the new general Language setting
• Voice — refreshed model catalog (gemini-2.5-flash + cloud default), faster TTS language switching
• Widget zoom — timer / voice / video feeds / music player now scale with widget_zoom
• SSL — self-signed cert trust extended to OkHttp (OAuth token exchange)
• Carries v1.0.9 fixes: SSL self-signed-cert for configured HA host, voice catalog refresh, half-hour timer parse
